report.heading: Your wellness plan
report.intro: Based on your answers, your body needs extra support in 10 key areas. Your full plan is below, with the breakdown at the end.

products.name: Core Potassium Complex
products.why: Your answers suggest your vitamin D intake is below your target, and you told us you get little sun. This one is a mineral.
products.description: A mineral carried in potatoes, bananas, pulses and leafy greens, and the most abundant one inside the body's own cells. Potassium contributes to normal muscle function and to the maintenance of normal blood pressure.

products.name: Core Multivitamin Gummies
products.why: Shown because you chose immunity as a goal. It contains vitamin C, which contributes to the normal function of the immune system. This one is a multi-nutrient blend.
products.description: A chewable multivitamin, set in pectin rather than gelatin, for anyone who would rather not swallow a capsule. Vitamin C contributes to the normal function of the immune system and to the reduction of tiredness and fatigue.

products.name: Renew Curcumin Complex
products.why: Part of the plan built from your answers. This one is a herbal extract.
products.description: The yellow pigment in turmeric root, and the reason curry stains. It absorbs poorly alone, so black pepper extract usually travels with it.

products.name: Renew Daily Marine Collagen
products.why: Included because you picked bone & joint health as a goal. It contains protein, which contributes to the maintenance of normal bones.
products.description: Collagen taken from fish skin rather than cattle hide. Type I, the kind most abundant in human skin.

products.name: Core Alpha Lipoic Acid
products.why: Included in the plan your answers built. This one is an antioxidant.
products.description: A fatty acid the body makes in small amounts, also found in spinach, broccoli and offal.

products.name: Core Garlic
products.why: Also part of the plan built from your answers. This one is a herbal extract.
products.description: Aged garlic oil, concentrated from Allium sativum and deodorised.

products.name: Core Lycopene
products.why: Part of the plan built from your answers. This one is a carotenoid.
products.description: The red pigment of the tomato, which the body takes up more readily once the fruit has been cooked.

products.name: Focus Quercetin Complex
products.why: Included in the plan your answers built. This one is a plant extract.
products.description: A plant pigment found in onion skin, capers and apple peel, paired here with the vitamin C it is usually taken alongside.

products.name: Renew Glucosamine Complex
products.why: Also part of the plan built from your answers. This one is a multi-nutrient blend.
products.description: A compound found in cartilage, usually made from the shells of shellfish.

products.name: Renew Hyaluronic Acid
products.why: Part of the plan built from your answers.
products.description: A molecule the body makes that holds many times its own weight in water, concentrated in skin, joints and the eye.

report.macros_note: Your intake is estimated from your height, weight, age and activity, then adjusted for your portion sizes and how often you skip meals. It is an estimate of a typical day, not a record of what you ate.

rows.name: Vitamin D3
rows.sources: Sources: eggs, vitamin-D-fortified foods and UV-exposed mushrooms. Food alone rarely covers vitamin D, particularly in winter.
